signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.intro: Use the username and password given to you by your school administrator.

home.title: Your exams
home.empty: You have no exams yet. Choose “New exam” to set one up.

newExam.title: New exam
newExam.noClasses: You have no classes yet. Ask your school administrator to create a class and assign it to you.

editor.title: Questions and mark scheme
editor.label: Question label
editor.pointsTotal: Points add up to {{total}} of {{max}} marks
editor.beforeReady: Complete these before marking the exam as ready:
editor.nowReady: The exam is ready. Cover sheets come next.
editor.confirmDelete: Delete this exam and its mark scheme? This cannot be undone.
editor.lockedHelp: The mark scheme can only be changed while the exam is a draft.

import.title: Import from a CSV file
import.help: One row per mark scheme point. Repeat the question columns on every row of the same question. Separate alternative answers with |. The first row must be:
import.problems: The file could not be imported:
import.summary: Found {{questions}} questions worth {{marks}} marks in total.
import.replaceWarning: This replaces the questions in the editor. Nothing is saved until you choose “Save mark scheme”.

users.title: Staff accounts
users.usernameHint: Letters, numbers, dots, dashes. Not case-sensitive.

students.privacyNote: Students are identified by their code on cover sheets and to the AI. Names are optional and stay on this computer.
students.empty: No students in this class yet.
students.name: Name
students.namesHint: Leave empty to add students by code only.
students.countHint: Used only when no names are entered.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

network.unreachable: The Marking Assistant server cannot be reached. Check that it is running on this computer or the school network.

server.error: The server had a problem. Please try again.

errors.not_found: This item does not exist, or you do not have access to it.
errors.forbidden: You are not allowed to do this.
errors.conflict: This change conflicts with the current state. Reload the page and try again.

auth.invalid_credentials: The username or password is incorrect.
auth.too_many_attempts: Too many failed attempts. Wait 15 minutes, or ask your administrator to reset your password.
auth.csrf_failed: Your session could not be verified. Reload the page and try again.

user.last_admin: The school must keep at least one active administrator.
user.cannot_deactivate_self: You cannot deactivate your own account.

class.duplicate: A class with this name already exists for that academic year.

exam.invalid_transition: The exam cannot move to that status now.
exam.has_scripts: Scans have been uploaded for this exam, so it can no longer return to draft.

request.invalid: Some information is missing or not valid.

upload.not_pdf: This file is not a PDF.

upload.duplicate_file: This exact file was already uploaded for this exam.
upload.not_failed: Only failed uploads can be tried again.
upload.pdf_unreadable: The PDF could not be opened. It may be damaged or password-protected. Scan it again.

upload.render_crashed: The PDF could not be processed. Try again, or scan it again.
upload.too_many_pages: The PDF has too many pages. Scan in smaller batches.
upload.processing_error: Something went wrong while processing this file. Try again.

page.already_assigned: Some pages are already in a script. Return them to the tray first.

script.locked: This script is already being marked; its pages cannot change.

ai.no_scripts: No scripts have been uploaded for this exam yet.

issues.unknown: There is a problem with this information.

exam.too_many_questions: An exam can have at most {{max}} questions.
exam.subject_unknown: Choose a subject from the list.

question.label_required: Every question needs a label, for example 1(a).
question.label_too_long: Question labels can be at most {{max}} characters.
question.label_duplicate: Label “{{label}}” is already used by question {{first}}.
question.max_marks_invalid: Maximum marks must be a whole number from 1 to {{max}}.
question.too_many_points: A question can have at most {{max}} mark scheme points.
question.no_points: Question {{label}} needs at least one mark scheme point.
question.points_below_max: Question {{label}}: points add up to {{points_total}}, less than the maximum of {{max_marks}}. Full marks would be impossible.
question.points_exceed_max: Question {{label}}: points add up to {{points_total}}, more than the maximum of {{max_marks}}. That is fine for “any {{max_marks}}” questions; marks will be capped at {{max_marks}}.

point.marks_invalid: Point marks must be a whole number from 1 to {{max}}.
point.description_required: Every mark scheme point needs a description.

class.teacher_invalid: Choose an active staff member as the teacher.

import.too_large: The file is larger than {{max_kb}} KB.
import.not_utf8: The file is not saved as UTF-8 text. In your spreadsheet, save as “CSV UTF-8”.
import.too_many_rows: The file has more than {{max}} rows.
import.row_extra_cells: Row {{row}} has more cells than there are columns.
import.max_marks_not_number: Row {{row}}: question maximum marks must be a whole number.
import.point_marks_not_number: Row {{row}}: point marks must be a whole number.
import.question_not_contiguous: Row {{row}}: the rows for question {{label}} must be next to each other.

sheets.needReady: Mark the exam as ready (after completing the mark scheme) before printing cover sheets or uploading scans.
sheets.noStudents: This class has no students yet. Ask your administrator to add them.
sheets.help: Print one cover sheet per student. Each student puts their sheet on top of their answer pages. After the exam, scan the whole stack in order.
sheets.privacy: Cover sheets show student codes only, never names. Use this list to hand out the sheets.

scans.uploadHelp: Choose one or more PDF files from the school scanner. Scan each class stack in order, cover sheets on top. Processing continues in the background.
scans.trayHelp: These pages could not be placed automatically. Check each one, then assign it to a student or discard it. Selecting a cover sheet also selects the pages that follow it.

reason.before_first_cover: Comes before the first cover sheet in the file.
reason.follows_unassigned_cover: Follows a cover sheet that could not be placed.
reason.qr_damaged: Cover sheet with a damaged QR code.
reason.qr_unreadable: Cover sheet found but code unreadable.
reason.qr_conflict: Two different QR codes on one page.
reason.qr_not_ours: Cover sheet with a QR code that was not made by this system.
reason.qr_bad_checksum: QR code read incorrectly (failed its check).
reason.unknown_sheet: Cover sheet not known to this installation.
reason.duplicate_in_upload: The same cover sheet appears twice in this file.
reason.already_uploaded: This student already has pages from an earlier upload.
reason.returned_by_teacher: Returned to the tray by a teacher.

pageFlag.no_answer_pages: Check: only a cover sheet, no answer pages.
pageFlag.more_than_usual: Check: more pages than usual (typical: {{typical}}). Another student's pages may have been added.
pageFlag.fewer_than_usual: Check: fewer pages than usual (typical: {{typical}}). Some pages may be missing.

ai.title: AI marking
ai.help: The AI transcribes each answer page and proposes marks with evidence. It runs in the background (often overnight). Nothing is final until a teacher confirms it.
ai.progress: Waiting: {{waiting}} · AI marked: {{marked}} · Need manual marking: {{flagged}}
ai.failedJobs: {{count}} tasks failed after several attempts. Check the warnings above, then start AI marking again to retry.
ai.workerOffline: The background worker is not running, so nothing will be processed. Restart the Marking Assistant.
ai.modelServerDown: The AI model server (Ollama) cannot be reached. Marking will start when it is back.
ai.modelMissing: The AI model {{model}} is not installed on the model server.

manualReason.unknown: The AI could not process this script.

ai.reader_invalid_output: The AI could not produce a valid transcription.
ai.marker_invalid_output: The AI could not propose valid marks for some questions.
ai.no_answer_pages: This script has no answer pages.
